title: Learning
subtitle: Knowledge-backed courses, practice, mastery, and spaced review
tagsNewPlaceholder: Type a tag name and press Enter
tagsApplyToChildren: Also append these tags to every question under this course
generateHint: AI designs a course blueprint first, then writes each lesson as a long-form study document (about 1000-1500 characters) with practice activities. Generation runs multiple model calls and takes a while; please wait.
generateDescriptionHint: AI designs the outline directly from your course brief and writes each lesson, no knowledge base involved. Generation takes a while with live progress; closing the dialog aborts it.
genTriageLine: Scanned {{total}} files → core {{core}} / mixed {{mixed}} / skipped {{skipped}} / duplicate {{duplicate}} / uncertain {{uncertain}}
genTriageDegraded: Rule-based triage; no LLM judgment was made
genUncertainTooMany: Too many uncertain files ({{count}}); consider tidying the knowledge base before generating
genCoverageReady: Coverage: {{covered}} topics into lessons / {{skipped}} explicitly skipped / {{fallback}} fallback lessons
genRunningHint: Generation takes a while; please be patient. Closing the dialog does not stop it.
genCancelRequested: Cancellation requested; stops at the next round boundary
genQueuedNotice: Task submitted; waiting in the queue for a free slot. You can cancel while queued.
genRetryResumeHint: Re-issues the original request; growth is an idempotent small-batch operation and never leaves half-applied state behind.
lessonGenSourceDegraded: Source base unreachable — this run falls back to the course snapshot
courseDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe the course you want, e.g. Master Rust ownership and lifetimes
describeRequired: Describe the course you want to create first
courseGoalPlaceholder: e.g. Learn Python data analysis from scratch; a multi-line goal description (audience, expected outcome) works too
courseGoalHint: The whole text is the goal: a short phrase is the course name, a longer text is the target description — the course title is exactly this text, and sampling and outline scope key off it.
selectKnowledgeBaseHint: Pick up to {{count}}: the first selection is the primary source; every selected library feeds sampling and lesson grounding.
kbSelectionTooMany: Up to {{count}} knowledge bases: deselect one to continue (extra selections are neither silently dropped nor submitted).
noUsableKnowledgeBases: No available knowledge base contains Markdown documents
domainPlaceholder: For example: futures trading, linear algebra

form.modelSelectTooltip: AI model used by learning (reflection grading, course generation, job retry; defaults to the system default)
form.modelUnavailableHint: This explicitly configured model is no longer available. Choose another model or Default Model.
form.modelPending: The model list is not ready yet. Please wait and retry, or pick a model first.

importHint: Paste CoursePack JSON. A pack may reference a knowledge base and source paths.
deleteCourseConsequenceContent: The course and its lesson content will be permanently removed.
deleteCourseConsequenceRecords: Learning records are kept: progress and XP already earned stay; this course disappears from every arrangement surface (review queue, ready recommendations, …).
deleteCourseConsequenceIrreversible: This cannot be undone — to pause the course without deleting it, archive it instead.
deleteCourseRequireInput: Type the course title "{{title}}" to confirm
deleteCourseMismatchHint: The input does not match the course title, so confirm stays disabled.
courseArchiveDone: Course archived: arrangement surfaces paused, learning records kept
courseRenameHint: Only the display title changes: the learning goal, structure snapshot and learning data stay untouched.
questionStateUnlearnedHint: Not in queue: this question is not in the review queue yet. Completing its lesson auto-queues it with the concept.
questionStateNewHint: First review: the card is in the review queue, waiting for its first review.
questionStateDueHint: Due: the review card is due and can be reviewed now.
questionStateScheduledHint: Scheduled: the review card is not due yet; it joins today's review session once due.
questionStateArchivedHint: Archived: this card is paused from the review queue and can be restored anytime.
questionQueueLegend: Not in queue = this question's lesson is not completed yet; First review = queued, awaiting first review; Due / Scheduled = enters today's review by due time.
questionQueueHintIn: This question's concept has a review card; it joins today's review session when due, and your rating reschedules the next review.
questionQueueHintOut: This question is not in the review queue yet: completing its lesson auto-queues it with the concept.
questionQueueHintCustom: Custom questions follow their own schedule and join today's review session when due.
questionCreated: Question added; it is ready to review right away
questionPromptRequired: The prompt must not be empty
questionOptionsRequired: At least two non-empty options are required
questionAnswerHint: Click the radio button next to an option to mark it as the correct answer
questionDeleteHint: This removes the review card only; the original activity inside the course is kept. Continue?
questionDeleteCustomHint: This permanently removes the custom question and its review schedule. Continue?
questionDistractorsHint: Near-synonym traps (optional): surface confusable terms; not used for grading
questionFillBlankHint: Mark the blank with ___ in the prompt
questionFillBlankHintRequired: Mark the blank with ___ in the prompt
xpEta: ~{{count}} days to finish at current pace
noCourseReviews: No review cards are due for this course
noCourses: No courses yet. Generate one from a knowledge base or import a course pack.
noDiagnosticQuestions: This course has no objective questions available for diagnosis
diagnosticComplete: Diagnostic complete. Your recommended path now reflects your mastery.
recommendationReason: Recommended from current mastery and prerequisite order
sourceUnavailable: This course is not linked to a knowledge base, so no source text is available
reviewForgotGate: Try to recall first — you can admit a lapse in {{seconds}}s
reviewGateBlocked: Already advanced today; this rating did not reschedule the card
reviewSkipped: Skipped — it will come back tomorrow
reviewArchived: Archived; it will no longer appear in the review queue
reviewUnarchived: Restored; it will re-enter the review queue
reviewRemovedFromQueue: Removed from the review queue; the original activity in the course is kept
reviewArchiveConfirmHint: This card has only been reviewed {{count}} times with a stability of {{days}} days, below the learning threshold. Archiving pauses its reviews (data is kept and it can be restored anytime). Archive it anyway?
reviewManageHint: Edit, archive or remove: part of memory programming
reviewManageHintFull: Spaced repetition is memory programming: adding, refining or removing review content is part of learning. Archiving never deletes data; restore it anytime in Questions.
reviewMarkEditPlaceholder: Optional: note what you want to change, to recall it when editing later
reviewForgotMarked: Marked as "forgot"; it will return shortly.
reviewRatePrompt: Correct. Rate how hard it was to recall:
reviewWrongMarkedAgain: Incorrect. Marked as "forgot"; it will return shortly.
packContract: A course pack contains Course, Module, Lesson, Concept, Activity, and SourceSpan. Domain evaluators extend this kernel.
generateQuestionHint: The AI reads the lesson body, the cited source, the course concepts and the existing questions, then writes one new question of the chosen kind that avoids repeating any of them.
questionFocusPlaceholder: e.g. target a specific point, or approach it from a new angle
questionGenerated: Draft ready — review and edit it, then confirm to add it to the lesson.
questionNoveltyHint: The AI avoids duplicating existing questions and prefers knowledge points they do not cover yet.

settings.title: Learning
settings.description: Memory-curve scheduler (FSRS) and review queue preferences
settings.desiredRetentionHint: Higher values schedule reviews sooner and more often (0.7–0.99, default 0.9)
settings.fsrsParametersHint: Comma-separated numbers. Leave empty to use the FSRS defaults; useful for importing optimized parameters from Anki.
settings.parametersInvalid: FSRS parameters must all be finite numbers
settings.reviewSessionLimitHint: Maximum due review cards loaded per session
settings.diagnosticLimitHint: Maximum questions sampled per knowledge diagnostic
settings.dailyXpGoalHint: Daily effort target in XP (1 XP ≈ one focused minute); the day completes on reaching it (1–1000, default 40)
settings.maintenanceAutoEnabledHint: Periodically consume structure-review findings and mount pending nodes (repair first, then mount; no model calls when there is no work)
settings.maintenanceIntervalMinutesHint: How often the automatic maintenance round runs (30–10080, default 360)
settings.wideContentHint: When off, the content column is centered with a width cap (course list and outline workspace 1200px, learning graph 1400px); when on, content fills the page and the lesson reading area becomes a full-width bordered panel with lines up to about 1040px. Shared by all three learning views.

learningGraphConceptsEmpty: No concepts yet — once the coach grows the first batch, the concepts they teach and assume will be listed here
learningGraphAuditFragmentsTooltip: Spans in the definition not covered by the lexicon (over-inclusive, includes tokenization noise): {{fragments}}
learningGraphAuditSelfRefTooltip: The definition mentions the concept's own canonical name (ISO 704 forbids self-reference)
learningGraphAuditMutualTooltip: References "{{name}}" and is referenced back — the shortest form of a circular definition
learningGraphBlockedAdvice: "{{title}}" is ready, but its supplier "{{supplier}}" was answered wrong recently — review {{due}} due cards of "{{supplier}}" (predicted recall {{percent}}%) first.
learningGraphHistoryEmpty: No growth history yet — the first batch of nodes will appear here
learningGraphGoalInputPlaceholder: e.g. a complete picture of options trading basics
learningGraphProficiencyPlaceholder: One line: what the learner can do independently on arrival, and at what depth; leave empty to let the system expand it from the goal
learningGraphBasisPlaceholder: One line: what the learner already knows; leave empty to design entry from a pure zero basis
learningGraphCreateHint: When the topic is complex or open-ended, use a learning graph: enter the goal, the system first generates a knowledge-structure reference map (spines and blocks), then grows study nodes one by one; study order follows the coach.
learningGraphRepairNoop: Round evaluated: no repair actions needed
learningGraphRepairStaleBanner: Structure repaired — existing mounts pending re-evaluation; run a mount round to re-evaluate
learningGraphStructureHint: The knowledge structure is an in-course reference map (spines and blocks) for orientation only; study order follows the coach.
learningGraphStructFooter: Projection only; layer = dependency depth, not a schedule.
learningGraphStructDetailNote: Compiled from course content for reference only; the actual study order follows the coach.
learningGraphGateHint: Door criteria and the blocks they cover (read-only reference): meeting a criterion implies its covered blocks are already mastered.
learningGraphEmpty: This graph has no nodes yet
learningGraphContentEmpty: Select a node from the sidebar to start learning
practiceGateHint: Answer every question in this section before moving on
sectionDegradedWarning: The visual promise for this section could not be delivered and it fell back to plain text; try an AI rewrite to restore the visual.
sectionRewriteDialogHint: Have the AI regenerate "{{title}}"; optionally attach a revision request.
sectionRewriteFeedbackPlaceholder: e.g. add an everyday example; walk through the derivation step by step; more conversational tone…
sectionEditDialogHint: Edit the Markdown body of this section; saving applies immediately and leaves everything else untouched.
practiceAllDone: All questions answered — review them below
samplingLineFallback: No goal match found; sampled {{sampled}}/{{total}} files in the default order
samplingTooltip: Files are selected by goal relevance, with a coherence budget adding structurally adjacent files (a course-style library keeps its chapter trunk intact); these low-score files were not sampled:
samplingTooltipEmpty: Files are selected by goal relevance, with a coherence budget adding structurally adjacent files; no low-score file was skipped this time.
samplingTooltipFallback: No file in the library matched the goal terms (the wording and the library content may disagree), so the default order was sampled; consider rewording the goal or adding matching notes to the knowledge base.
costGateHint: This course is large and will consume many model calls; generation starts after you confirm. Triage counts here are a preview — the real run triages again.
sourceCoverageUnavailable: Source coverage unavailable: unrecognized snapshot version; the course itself still works
sourceCoverageDestinations: {{prereq}} prerequisite topics and {{practice}} practice topics entered lessons
sourceCoverageMixed: {{count}} mixed files (part of their content entered the course)
sourceCoverageAnchorUncertain: {{count}} topics with imprecise anchors (fell back to file level)
sourceCoverageFallback: {{count}} fallback lessons (built from headings/file names, not a normal design)
sourceCoverageDuplicates: {{count}} duplicates / translated copies did not enter the course
